Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Geometric Handwoven Round Basket Set - Set of 3, White / Black
Enhance your modern-style décor with this striking accent basket. Handwoven with cotton, this basket features an intricate geometric pattern around its circumference. Its neutral black-and-white colors blend well with most home-décor color schemes. Dimensions measure 14"L X 14"W X 14"H, 10"L X 10"W X 10"H, 6"L X 6"W X 6"H Handmade with cotton This modern-style basket can be used for both storage and display.
